owner_calls.question: Captain America's last stage is the Six American Warriors. On screen (Spider-Man 1994, 'Secrets of the Six') the Six 'all moved on' after WWII and were forgotten, then the five reunite 50 years later and Cap fights beside them before being lost in the vortex again; in X-Men '97 ep 7 ('Bright Eyes') Cap works with the U.S. government / General Ross and mentions having a team that is never named (the wiki guesses the Avengers). Should his last stage change?
options: Keep Six American Warriors as the last stage (unsure case)
Add left 'Spider-Man (1994)' (the Six break up after the war and again after Six Forgotten Warriors)
Add an X-Men '97 stage for his unnamed team / U.S. government work (needs a name the owner accepts)
owner_calls.evidence: marvel.fandom Six American Warriors (Earth-92131): 'After the war ended, the remaining five were ordered to disband... the remaining five warriors disbanded once again' (status Defunct), but the S5E6 episode page does not record a disbanding. Steven Rogers (Earth-92131) page: in X-Men '97 S1E7 'Cap began working for the United States government and became associated with General Ross'; trivia: 'Captain America mentions having a team, likely referring to the Avengers' (not named on screen).
